description_en: Queries the information about Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances associated with website services
description_zh: 查询网站业务关联的DDoS高防实例信息
name: DescribeWebInstanceRelations

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain names of the website services.

The domain names must have website service forwarding rules configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名列表。

域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domains

WebInstanceRelations.description_en: The information about Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances associated with website services
WebInstanceRelations.description_zh: 网站业务关联的DDoS高防实例信息
